blocks.text: SALT LAKE CITY— Franz Wagner matched a career high with 38 points and had eight rebounds to lead the Orlando Magic to a 123-108 victory over Utah in the NBA on Wednesday night, the 10th straight loss for the Jazz. Desmond Bane had 25 points while Anthony Black chipped in 22 points and eight assists to help the Magic earn their second straight win and close out a four-game road trip with a 2-2 record.
